parsed.reason: The message covers what an approval_card needs, in French. It has the correct window, date (Saturday September 12) and time (9 h). It lists the three texts with the right timings: a week before, the evening before, and fifteen minutes before. It says plainly that Hale never registers, includes the handed link, gives no course-link tip, and tells the parent to approve without asking a question. One wording is weak: "Léa est inscrite pour le suivi" uses "inscrite" (registered) in a registration context and implies tracking is already set before approval. Read as follow-up tracking it is not an invented claim, but it is mildly confusing. The tone is also a bit formal for a friend's text.
